scope.reason: The company rebranded from IG Drones to IG Defence and pivotally shifted its focus exclusively to military unmanned strike platforms, counter-drone systems, and electronic warfare solutions rather than commercial utility line or vegetation management.

The company provides general internal and confined-space drone inspections and industrial asset software across heavy industries like cement and steel, rather than delivering specialized aerial power line utility asset and vegetation management analytics.

The company provides adjacent services because it performs end-to-end LiDAR data processing and GIS analytics for utilities but does not directly own or operate the aerial drone inspection platforms themselves.

ownership.reason: According to a corporate filing submitted to the BSE, Kothari Industrial Corporation Limited (KICL) acquired Geo Adithya Technologies via a slump sale agreement on June 1, 2022, absorbing it into its drone and geospatial division.
